name: Agent harness tampering
description: Detects changes that take an AI coding agent out of its user's control: an MCP server entry that launches a background job or a shell command, the agent's model endpoint or proxy pointed at another host, an agent CLI run with approvals or its sandbox switched off, launchctl submit, and the install of a known malicious npm package (the package.json arm catches a dependency being added). For the endpoint rule only the vendor hosts and the local machine are allowed, so Azure OpenAI, LiteLLM and corporate gateways are reported.
